scope: All 32 pooled investment vehicles in the 7 September 2026 statement, including private-equity vehicles.
methodology: Themes summarize an investment mandate or disclosed historical portfolio; they are descriptive labels, not exact allocations.
Named constituents are included only from identified primary fund documents or official manager holdings tables with dates on or before the account statement.
Historical fund weights applied to statement market values would be indicative look-through estimates, not verified statement-date exposures. No such dollar amounts are calculated in this file.
Top-ten extracts are partial. Missing companies are unknown rather than zero. Each fund market value must be counted once; do not add its full value to every theme or named company.
Fund shares, ordinary shares, ADRs, options, structured payoffs and commodity exposure have different units. Company matching does not make their quantities or sensitivities interchangeable.
Issuer weights from the Franklin mixed-asset fund are kept distinct from equity weights. Later current fund snapshots were excluded from historical constituent data.
